The Cursed One#000.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.
The Cursed One#000.dst: 축제가 왕실 중심으로 돌아가긴 해도, 우리 문화를 보여 준다는 점은 늘 좋았어요.

The Cursed One#001.src: Good job friend! You showed those mudkins!
The Cursed One#001.dst: 잘했어, 친구! Mudkin들한테 본때를 보여 줬네!

The Cursed One#002.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly- we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#002.dst: 요즘 들어 우리 활동에 영향력이 없다는 걸 절실히 느꼈어요. 물론- 짓밟히고 외면당한 이들에게 좋은 일은 했죠! 하지만 진짜 변화는 전혀 만들지 못했어요.

The Cursed One#003.src: Yeah, curses, blessings - whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#003.dst: 그래, 저주든 축복이든 - 아무튼. 그래서 뭐, 우리 모두 그냥... "마법"을 쓸 수 있다고? 그게 대체 어떤 건데?

The Cursed One#004.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has the afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#004.dst: 하지만 전통적인 "저주받은 자" 신화에선, 저주받은 이가 축복받은 도구 없이도 그런 힘을 휘두르죠.

The Cursed One#005.src: As an example- I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#005.dst: 예를 들어- 난 화염 속성에 적성이 있다는 걸 알았지만, 실제로 축복을 받기 전까진 어떤 형태일지 몰랐어요.

The Cursed One#006.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#007.src: {u}, it's good to see you. Have you been well?
The Cursed One#007.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#008.src: ...no one has recognized you in {p}, have they?
The Cursed One#008.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#009.src: Good, good. Be sure to tell me if it does happen, and we'll figure out what to do from there.
The Cursed One#009.dst: 좋아요, 좋아. 혹시 그런 일이 생기면 꼭 말해 줘요. 그때 방법을 찾아보죠.
The Cursed One#009.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#010.src: Anyway, since you're here, I'd like to follow up on our earlier discussion. About... magic.
The Cursed One#010.dst: 아무튼 왔으니, 저번에 하던 얘기를 이어 가고 싶어요. 그... 마법에 대해서요.
The Cursed One#010.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#011.src: I would like for you to describe what you know of it, how you use it, and how most people in your province can wield it.
The Cursed One#011.dst: 마법에 대해 아는 것, 당신이 쓰는 방법, 당신네 지방 사람 대부분이 어떻게 다루는지 설명해 줬으면 해요.
The Cursed One#011.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#012.src: I've informed the Leaves about our plans, and those interested will join us. Though, I will not force anyone to attend if they do not wish to. Are you ready?
The Cursed One#012.dst: 잎새들에게 계획을 알렸고, 관심 있는 사람은 올 거예요. 원치 않는 사람을 억지로 부르진 않을 거고요. 준비됐어요?
The Cursed One#012.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#014.src: Teach the Leaves in the Wind magic.

The Cursed One#015.src: Hello, everyone. Hm... has anyone seen Sui?
The Cursed One#015.dst: 다들 안녕. 흠... Sui 본 사람?
The Cursed One#015.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#016.src: She told me she did not feel particularly comfortable listening in on this discussion, so I did not push her further.
The Cursed One#016.dst: 이 논의를 듣는 게 그다지 편치 않다고 해서, 더 권하진 않았어요.
The Cursed One#016.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#017.src: I see. I think it would be good for her to hear this, though. Could someone fetch her for me?
The Cursed One#017.dst: 그렇구나. 그래도 Sui가 들어 두면 좋을 것 같은데. 누가 좀 데려와 줄래?
The Cursed One#017.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#018.src: I can go find her, ma'am.
The Cursed One#018.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#020.src: It... isn't something you need to worry about. Not yet, at least.
The Cursed One#020.dst: 그건... 신경 쓸 일이 아니야. 적어도 아직은.
The Cursed One#020.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#021.src: Magic... or, rather, curses have a tendency to be associated with bad memories.
The Cursed One#021.dst: 마법... 아니, 저주는 나쁜 기억과 엮이기 쉬워요.
The Cursed One#021.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#022.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#022.dst: 이유는 내가 말할 게 아니에요. Sui가 원하면 나중에 직접 말해 줄 거예요.
The Cursed One#022.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#024.src: I have my reasons for it. I believe it would be better for her to hear this now, rather than later.
The Cursed One#024.dst: 나름의 이유가 있어요. 나중보다 지금 듣는 게 그 애한테 나을 거라고 믿어요.
The Cursed One#024.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#025.src: It's not my place to tell you why. Sui can share more if she wants to, later.
The Cursed One#025.dst: 이유는 내가 말할 게 아니에요. Sui가 원하면 나중에 직접 말해 줄 거예요.
The Cursed One#025.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#026.src: Here we are! So, could we get started already? Some of us actually have responsibilities.
The Cursed One#026.dst: 데려왔어요! 그럼 이제 시작할까요? 누구는 할 일이 있거든요.
The Cursed One#026.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#027.src: Seeing as everyone is here, yes, Rex, we may. {u}, let us start with the basics.
The Cursed One#027.dst: 다 모였으니, 그래, Rex, 시작하자. {u}, 기초부터 시작하죠.
The Cursed One#027.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#028.src: Ah, yes, such as the cursed... the stories do tell of the original evil lurking within us. It would follow that it exists in all things.
The Cursed One#028.dst: 아, 그렇죠, 저주받은 자처럼... 이야기에선 원초적인 악이 우리 안에 숨어 있다고 하죠. 그렇다면 만물에 있다는 말이 되겠군요.
The Cursed One#028.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#029.src: Indeed. So {u}, how do you wield your magic?
The Cursed One#029.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#030.src: Similar to the blessed implements of the crown's commanders, yes? I remember hearing of this from the military recruiters.
The Cursed One#030.dst: 왕실 지휘관들의 축복받은 도구랑 비슷한 거죠? 군 모병관한테서 들은 기억이 나요.
The Cursed One#030.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#031.src: Don't those usually only have one specific blessing attached to them? I don't remember them being as... uh, flexible, I guess.
The Cursed One#031.dst: 그건 보통 특정 축복 하나만 붙어 있지 않아요? 그렇게... 어, 유연했던 기억은 없는데.
The Cursed One#031.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#032.src: You'd be correct, Rex, though the same principle applies. A blessed weapon is referred to as a "focus" by the crown. They allow the wielder to more easily access the blessing placed within.
The Cursed One#032.dst: 맞아, Rex. 그래도 원리는 같아. 왕실은 축복받은 무기를 "매개체"라고 불러. 쓰는 사람이 안에 담긴 축복을 더 쉽게 끌어내게 해 주지.
The Cursed One#032.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#033.src: Ah, I do have experience with this. We call it mana. Once one receives a blessing, it takes time to learn how to draw from your own source of mana.
The Cursed One#033.dst: 아, 그건 나도 겪어 봤어요. 우린 마나라고 불러요. 축복을 받고 나면, 자기 마나를 끌어 쓰는 법을 익히는 데 시간이 걸리죠.
The Cursed One#033.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#034.src: This is where foci come into play they are crafted or forged from mana-dense materials, and so provide a more easily accessible source to power one's blessing.
The Cursed One#034.dst: 여기서 매개체가 쓰여요. 마나가 풍부한 재료로 만들거나 벼려서, 축복을 부릴 원천을 더 쉽게 끌어 쓰게 해 주죠.
The Cursed One#034.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#035.src: And, so... what? You think any of us could just... do it? That's hard to believe.
The Cursed One#035.dst: 그래서... 뭐? 우리 누구나 그냥... 할 수 있다고? 믿기 힘든데.
The Cursed One#035.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#036.src: Ha! If it were truly the case, would there not be many, many more cursed ones running around? I concur with Rex, it seems outlandish.
The Cursed One#036.dst: 하! 정말 그렇다면, 저주받은 자가 훨씬, 훨씬 더 많이 돌아다니지 않겠어요? Rex 말에 동의해요, 터무니없어 보여요.
The Cursed One#036.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#037.src: I d- d- don't know... {u} doesn't seem like they're l- ly- like they're lying. What- wh- what if it is true?
The Cursed One#037.dst: 모, 모, 모르겠어... {u}이(가) 거, 거짓- 거짓말하는 것 같진 않아. 그, 그- 그게 사실이면?
The Cursed One#037.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#038.src: It would explain certain aspects of the crown's response to cursed ones...
The Cursed One#038.dst: 왕실이 저주받은 자에게 보이는 반응 일부가 설명되긴 하네...
The Cursed One#038.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#039.src: But... if you didn't receive a blessing, doesn't it still make you cursed?
The Cursed One#039.dst: 그치만... 축복을 안 받았으면, 그래도 저주받은 거 아니야?
The Cursed One#039.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#040.src: Yes, precisely! My sister is correct. Any... "magic" not sourced from the crown is innately tainted, from my understanding.
The Cursed One#040.dst: 그래요, 바로 그거예요! 동생 말이 맞아요. 내가 알기로 왕실에서 나오지 않은... "마법"은 본질적으로 더럽혀진 거예요.
The Cursed One#040.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#041.src: Yeah, curses, blessings whatever. So, what, you think all of us could just... use "magic"? What would that even look like?
The Cursed One#041.dst: 그래, 저주든 축복이든 아무튼. 그래서 뭐, 우리 모두 그냥... "마법"을 쓸 수 있다고? 그게 대체 어떤 건데?
The Cursed One#041.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#042.src: Ha. Right, sure. "Belief." So if I think hard enough, I can just start calling down lightning strikes?
The Cursed One#042.dst: 하. 그래, 퍽이나. "믿음"이라. 그럼 세게 생각만 하면 번개라도 내리칠 수 있다고?
The Cursed One#042.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#043.src: Ugh. This was a waste of time.
The Cursed One#043.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#044.src: Now, now, Rex. Don't be so hasty in writing it off entirely. You have seen with your own eyes what {u} can do!
The Cursed One#044.dst: 자자, Rex. 그렇게 성급히 다 무시하지 말아요. {u}이(가) 뭘 할 수 있는지 직접 봤잖아요!
The Cursed One#044.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#045.src: Belief... I- I- I can do that.
The Cursed One#045.dst: 믿음... 나, 나, 나도 할 수 있어.
The Cursed One#045.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#046.src: Oh, come on Zeph, really? You can't seriously
The Cursed One#046.dst: 아, 좀, Zeph, 진심이야? 설마 진짜로
The Cursed One#046.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#047.src: We're getting off track. {u}, what else is there?
The Cursed One#047.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#048.src: So... s- so you don't even know what your m- ma- magic will look like?
The Cursed One#048.dst: 그럼... 그, 그럼 네 마, 마법이 어떤 모습일지도 모르는 거야?
The Cursed One#048.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#049.src: Correct. There are aptitude tests which the crown uses before giving out blessings, but those only provide an idea of the general typing.
The Cursed One#049.dst: 맞아. 왕실이 축복을 주기 전에 적성 검사를 하긴 하는데, 대략적인 유형만 알 수 있어.
The Cursed One#049.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#050.src: As an example I learned that I have an affinity for the fire element, but I didn't know what form that would take until I actually received my blessing.
The Cursed One#050.dst: 예를 들어 난 화염 속성에 적성이 있다는 걸 알았지만, 실제로 축복을 받기 전까진 어떤 형태일지 몰랐어.
The Cursed One#050.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#051.src: Oh! S- s- so, what type of magic do you think I w- would- I would have?
The Cursed One#051.dst: 오! 그, 그, 그럼 나는 어, 어떤- 어떤 마법일 것 같아?
The Cursed One#051.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#052.src: Something with wind, probably. You have that sort of... feel to you. Hey we'll be the Leaves, and you can be the Wind!
The Cursed One#052.dst: 아마 바람 계열이겠지. 너한텐 그런... 느낌이 있어. 야, 우리가 잎새면 넌 바람 하면 되겠다!
The Cursed One#052.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#053.src: He- hey! That... oh, that would be c- c- cool, actually...
The Cursed One#053.dst: 야, 야! 그건... 아, 사실 좀 머, 머, 멋지겠다...
The Cursed One#053.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#054.src: If I may interrupt thus far, you have spoken at length on casting through the use of a focus.
The Cursed One#054.dst: 잠시 끼어들자면, 지금까지 매개체를 통한 시전만 길게 얘기했어요.
The Cursed One#054.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#055.src: However, the traditional "cursed one" mythos has afflicted wielding such power without the use of any blessed artifacts.
The Cursed One#055.dst: 하지만 전통적인 "저주받은 자" 신화에선, 저주받은 이가 축복받은 도구 없이 그런 힘을 휘두르죠.
The Cursed One#055.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#056.src: Aha. Of course, then those must be the dangerous ones.
The Cursed One#056.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#058.src: Uncommon, but still common enough to maintain the reputation the cursed have... It would make sense.
The Cursed One#058.dst: 흔하진 않지만 저주받은 자의 평판이 유지될 만큼은 흔하다... 말이 되네요.
The Cursed One#058.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#059.src: Well, thank you for your time, {u}. I think we'll call it there. You're all dismissed.
The Cursed One#059.dst: 자, 시간 내 줘서 고마워요, {u}. 오늘은 여기까지 하죠. 다들 해산.
The Cursed One#059.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#060.src: ...So what, is- is that it? We talk about th- th- theory for a while, and th- a- and then do nothing?
The Cursed One#060.dst: ...그래서 뭐, 이- 이게 끝이야? 이, 이, 이론만 좀 떠들고, 그- 그, 그러고 아무것도 안 해?
The Cursed One#060.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#061.src: Zeph, even if {u}'s information is true, it doesn't mean it's immediately applicable.
The Cursed One#061.dst: Zeph, {u}의 정보가 사실이라 해도 바로 써먹을 수 있다는 뜻은 아니야.
The Cursed One#061.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#062.src: If I could be certain that experimenting with cur... magic... would be safe, maybe there could be an opportunity here. As it stands... it's too risky.
The Cursed One#062.dst: 저, 아니 마법 실험이... 안전하다고 확신할 수 있다면, 기회가 될 수도 있겠지. 지금으로선... 너무 위험해.
The Cursed One#062.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#063.src: R- ris- risky... maybe the reason we've been stuck is because we d- d- we don't take risks!
The Cursed One#063.dst: 위, 위험- 위험... 우리가 제자리인 건 우, 우, 우리가 위험을 안 무릅써서일지도 몰라!
The Cursed One#063.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#064.src: The per- perfect opportunity to be a- a- able to hold our own against the c- cr- crown, a- and- and we're gonna do n- no- nothing? Are you h- hear- hearing yourself?
The Cursed One#064.dst: 와, 완, 완벽한 기회야, 와, 왕실에 맞, 맞설 수 있는! 그, 그런데- 그런데 아, 아, 아무것도 안 한다고? 네가 하는 말 드, 들, 들리긴 해?
The Cursed One#064.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#066.src: No, I- I'm gonna ta- take the chance. Even- e- even if no- nobody else will. Come- c- come on, {u}, let's go.
The Cursed One#066.dst: 아니, 나- 난 해 볼 거야. 아, 아- 아무도 안 한대도. 가, 가- 가자, {u}, 가자.
The Cursed One#066.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#068.src: Sigh. I suppose I should have expected something like this. Of all the children, he's the one with the most to prove...
The Cursed One#068.dst: 하아. 이럴 줄 알았어야 했는데. 애들 중에 증명할 게 제일 많은 게 그 애니까...
The Cursed One#068.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#069.src: You may as well go with him, {u}. Maybe you'll be able to prove my worries wrong.
The Cursed One#069.dst: 같이 가 줘요, {u}. 내 걱정이 틀렸다는 걸 보여 줄지도 모르죠.
The Cursed One#069.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#070.src: Hum... I suppose the pieces fit together, yet...
The Cursed One#070.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#072.src: I... I may have gotten a bit h- he- heated there...
The Cursed One#072.dst: 나... 나 아까 좀 흐, 흥, 흥분했나 봐...
The Cursed One#072.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#073.src: It's just... all so- s- so frustrating! So often, people are h- hur- hurt by the crown, and- and th- there's nothing we can do about it! If we had m- m- if we had m- magic, we'd be able to- to sta- stand up to them!
The Cursed One#073.dst: 그냥... 너무- 너, 너무 답답해! 사람들이 왕실 때문에 다, 다, 다치는데, 우, 우린 아무것도 못 해! 우리한테 마, 마, 우리한테 마, 마법이 있으면, 마, 맞설 수 있을 텐데!
The Cursed One#073.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#074.src: But they don't... eugh. What- wh- whatever. We can just
The Cursed One#074.dst: 근데 다들... 으. 뭐, 뭐- 뭐 어때. 우리끼리 그냥
The Cursed One#074.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#077.src: Well, I can't just let you go off and do this on your own. Even if I think it's stupid and reckless.
The Cursed One#077.dst: 뭐, 너 혼자 이런 짓 하러 가게 둘 순 없잖아. 멍청하고 무모한 짓이라고 생각해도.
The Cursed One#077.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#078.src: So, what's the plan? You didn't just run off without one, right?
The Cursed One#078.dst: 그래서, 계획은? 계획도 없이 뛰쳐나온 건 아니지?
The Cursed One#078.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#081.src: Hey! I know that I- I need a f- fo- focus, right? We just need to find some... s- some magical materials to ma- make it out of. Even if I- I- I don't know where to... look.
The Cursed One#081.dst: 야! 나도 매, 매, 매개체가 필요하다는 건 알아! 그걸 만들 마, 마법 재료를... 조, 좀 찾으면 돼. 어, 어, 어디서 찾을진... 모르지만.
The Cursed One#081.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#082.src: Sigh. Okay. Well, luckily for you, I know a spot. Remember that cave to the west of the festival grounds? Soldiers were swarming the place a week or two ago. Blocked it off 'cause of... cursed activity, or something.
The Cursed One#082.dst: 하아. 알았어. 운 좋게도 내가 아는 데가 있어. 축제장 서쪽 동굴 기억나? 한두 주 전에 병사들이 우글거렸잖아. 저주받은 자의 활동인가 뭔가 때문에 막아 버렸어.
The Cursed One#082.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#083.src: And... y- you- you think there might be s- some- something there?
The Cursed One#083.dst: 그럼... 거, 거기- 거기에 뭐, 뭔가 있을 것 같아?
The Cursed One#083.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#084.src: Yep! Why else would they prevent people from going there for so long? There's gotta be something.
The Cursed One#084.dst: 응! 아니면 왜 그렇게 오래 사람을 막았겠어? 분명 뭔가 있어.
The Cursed One#084.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#085.src: Okay. It's w- worth a shot... Thanks for the help, Rex.
The Cursed One#085.dst: 좋아. 해, 해 볼 만하네... 도와줘서 고마워, Rex.
The Cursed One#085.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#086.src: Don't mention it. We'll just have to follow those blue flowers, they'll lead us right to the cave. I'll stand guard outside while you two search it.
The Cursed One#086.dst: 됐어. 저 파란 꽃만 따라가면 바로 동굴이야. 둘이 뒤지는 동안 난 밖에서 망볼게.
The Cursed One#086.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#088.src: Head to the blocked off cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#089.src: ...Hm? What? I'm not here for you, just to be clear.
The Cursed One#089.dst: ...응? 뭐? 분명히 말하는데, 너 때문에 온 거 아니야.
The Cursed One#089.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#090.src: You should stop wasting time talking to me, and hurry up after Zeph already.
The Cursed One#090.dst: 나랑 떠들며 시간 낭비 말고 얼른 Zeph나 쫓아가.
The Cursed One#090.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#091.src: He's probably trying to compete with you to see who can get to the end fastest, and every second you spend here is not doing you any favors in beating him.
The Cursed One#091.dst: 아마 누가 끝까지 먼저 가나 너랑 시합하는 중일 텐데, 여기서 보내는 1초마다 걔를 이기는 데 손해야.
The Cursed One#091.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#092.src: Heh. Not that you'd win anyway!
The Cursed One#092.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#093.src: Hah! Too s- sl- slow! I guess I probably sh- should- should've warned you about the r- roly-bugs...
The Cursed One#093.dst: 하! 너, 너, 너무 느려! 로, 롤리벌레 얘기를 해 줬어야 했나 봐...
The Cursed One#093.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#094.src: If you're quiet en- enough, they usually don't bother you. I th- th- I think you even woke up the lea- leader of the colony!
The Cursed One#094.dst: 조, 조용히만 하면 보통 안 건드려. 나, 나, 내 생각엔 네가 무리 우, 우두머리까지 깨운 것 같아!
The Cursed One#094.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#095.src: Anyway... I think Rex was right. Lo- look at these crystals! If- if a- any- anything's magical, it's got to be them!
The Cursed One#095.dst: 아무튼... Rex 말이 맞았나 봐. 이, 이 수정 좀 봐! 뭐, 뭐라도 마법이 있다면 이거일 거야!
The Cursed One#095.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#096.src: Let's grab some and g- get- get out of here. We don't want to get c- cau- caught in a res- restricted area.
The Cursed One#096.dst: 몇 개 챙겨서 나, 나가자. 제, 제한 구역에서 자, 잡히면 안 되잖아.
The Cursed One#096.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#097.src: I'll take one... M- may- maybe we should take some more? In ca- c- in case anyone else wants to- y- you know. Co- coming back here again later would be da- dangerous.
The Cursed One#097.dst: 난 하나 가질게... 아, 아마 더 챙기는 게 낫겠지? 호, 혹, 혹시 다른 사람도- 알, 알잖아. 나중에 다시 오는 건 위, 위험하니까.
The Cursed One#097.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#098.src: Grab a crystal before you leave.

The Cursed One#099.src: Took you long enough! So, who won the race?
The Cursed One#099.dst: 오래도 걸렸네! 그래서, 시합은 누가 이겼어?
The Cursed One#099.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#100.src: You say that like you don't a- al- already know, Rex!
The Cursed One#100.dst: 이, 이, 이미 알면서 묻는 것 같다, Rex!
The Cursed One#100.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#101.src: Excuses, excuses. You should always have your guard up around Zeph. You never know when he'll strike with a surprise race.
The Cursed One#101.dst: 핑계, 핑계. Zeph 옆에선 항상 경계해. 언제 기습 시합을 걸지 모르거든.
The Cursed One#101.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#105.src: Sure, Zeph. Well, what'd you find? I haven't seen anybody out here, so I think we're in the clear to go if we're done here.
The Cursed One#105.dst: 그래, Zeph. 그래서 뭘 찾았어? 밖엔 아무도 없었으니, 다 됐으면 가도 될 것 같아.
The Cursed One#105.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#106.src: We fou- found some crystals growing at the end of the cave. They f- fe- feel magical to me, so... they should w- wor- work. Let's get going back.
The Cursed One#106.dst: 동굴 끝에서 자라는 수정을 차, 찾았어. 마, 마법이 느껴지니까... 쓸 수 이, 있을 거야. 돌아가자.
The Cursed One#106.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#107.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#108.src: Come on. Just because we're in the clear now doesn't mean we can dilly-dally. Let's go.
The Cursed One#108.dst: 가자. 지금 안전하다고 꾸물대도 되는 건 아니야. 가자.
The Cursed One#108.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#109.src: Let's get going back. I r- really hope these crystals w- wor- work.
The Cursed One#109.dst: 돌아가자. 이 수정이 제발 제, 제대로 되, 되면 좋겠다.
The Cursed One#109.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#110.src: ...Ah! You return! I'd best inform miss Syndra of your arrival.
The Cursed One#110.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#111.src: You were wai- waiting for us? Why?
The Cursed One#111.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#112.src: Hrm... I suppose your words resonated with me, in the end. Having taken some time to mull it over while you were gone... I must admit, you make a solid point.
The Cursed One#112.dst: 흠... 결국 당신 말이 마음에 와닿았나 봐요. 없는 동안 곰곰이 생각해 봤는데... 인정할 수밖에 없네요, 일리가 있어요.
The Cursed One#112.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#113.src: As of late, I have felt a distinct lack of impact in our actions. Certainly we've done good for the downtrodden and overlooked! But we have failed to make any real change.
The Cursed One#113.dst: 요즘 들어 우리 활동에 영향력이 없다는 걸 절실히 느꼈어요. 물론 짓밟히고 외면당한 이들에게 좋은 일은 했죠! 하지만 진짜 변화는 전혀 만들지 못했어요.
The Cursed One#113.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#114.src: Well, you're not the only one feeling that way, if it makes you feel any better. I think Syndra's the same.
The Cursed One#114.dst: 뭐, 그렇게 느끼는 게 너만은 아니야, 위안이 된다면. Syndra도 같을걸.
The Cursed One#114.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#115.src: Even more reason to try something new, then! This... magic, as you call it- if indeed it is what you have described, though I still have my doubts-
The Cursed One#115.dst: 그렇다면 새로운 걸 시도할 이유가 더 생긴 셈이군요! 이... 당신이 마법이라 부르는 것- 정말 당신이 설명한 그대로라면 말이죠, 아직 의심스럽긴 하지만-
The Cursed One#115.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#117.src: Yes, Rex, I appreciate the encouragement as I was saying, it could be just what we need to truly make a difference.
The Cursed One#117.dst: 그래요, Rex, 격려 고마워요 아무튼, 진짜 변화를 만드는 데 딱 필요한 걸지도 몰라요.
The Cursed One#117.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#118.src: ...I h- ho- hope so. Um... you were g- go- going to tell Syndra we were back?
The Cursed One#118.dst: ...그, 그러면 좋겠다. 음... Syndra한테 우리 도, 돌아왔다고 말하러 간다며?
The Cursed One#118.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#119.src: So I was! Allow me one moment, please.
The Cursed One#119.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#120.src: ...You're really sure you want to go through with this, Zeph?
The Cursed One#120.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#121.src: I- I am. I w- wa- I want to try it! Maybe then, I could...
The Cursed One#121.dst: 하, 할 거야. 해, 해- 해 보고 싶어! 그러면 어쩌면 나도...
The Cursed One#121.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#122.src: Okay! Okay. It's your choice. I just worry sometimes!
The Cursed One#122.dst: 알았어! 알았다고. 네 선택이야. 가끔 걱정될 뿐이야!
The Cursed One#122.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#123.src: I... I ne- need to get into the r- r- right mood for it, I thi- I- I think. I'm... kind of ner- nervous, actually.
The Cursed One#123.dst: 나... 기분을 제, 제, 제대로 잡아야 할 것 같아, 아마- 아, 아마도. 사실... 좀 긴, 긴장돼.
The Cursed One#123.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#124.src: ...Hey, {u}, could you... do- d- do some magic. As a- a d- dem- demonstration!
The Cursed One#124.dst: ...저기, {u}, 마법 좀... 보, 보, 보여 줄래? 시, 시, 시범으로!
The Cursed One#124.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#126.src: N- no, she- she's just paranoid. It'll be f- f- fine! You were casting sp- spells in the cave a- and- and nothing bad happened!
The Cursed One#126.dst: 아, 아니, 그- 그냥 걱정이 많은 거야. 괘, 괘, 괜찮을 거야! 동굴에서도 주, 주문 썼는데- 아무 일도 없었잖아!
The Cursed One#126.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#127.src: Sigh. If you insist, Zeph. Whatever you do had better be cool though, {u}.
The Cursed One#127.dst: 하아. 네가 그렇게까지 말한다면, Zeph. 근데 뭘 하든 멋져야 할 거다, {u}.
The Cursed One#127.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#128.src: Hm, I don't quite like the sound of "probably".
The Cursed One#128.dst: 흠, "아마"라는 말은 좀 마음에 안 드는데.
The Cursed One#128.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#129.src: Good- g- good enough for me! Come on, {u}, sh- show- show me a spell!
The Cursed One#129.dst: 그, 그- 그거면 충분해! 자, {u}, 주, 주문 보, 보여 줘!
The Cursed One#129.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#130.src: Showcase magic by casting spells in the resistance camp.
The Cursed One#130.dst: 저항군 야영지에서 주문을 시전해 마법을 보여 주세요.

The Cursed One#131.src: Woah! That w- was cool! Can you d- do- do it again?
The Cursed One#131.dst: 우와! 머, 멋지다! 또 해, 해 줄 수 있어?
The Cursed One#131.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#133.src: What's going on out here? I heard
The Cursed One#133.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#134.src: {u} is show- sh- showing me some magic!
The Cursed One#134.dst: {u}이(가) 마, 마법을 보, 보여 주고 있어!
The Cursed One#134.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#135.src: ... I take it you found what you were looking for then?
The Cursed One#135.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#136.src: Yup. Cursed crystals from the roly-nest.
The Cursed One#136.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#137.src: The... of all places, you went to the roly-nest?! Did you even consider the risk?!
The Cursed One#137.dst: 그... 하필이면 롤리벌레 둥지에 갔다고?! 위험은 생각이나 했어?!
The Cursed One#137.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#138.src: What if you were caught? We are only able to operate here because we avoid drawing attention to ourselves. If you had been seen
The Cursed One#138.dst: 잡혔으면 어쩔 뻔했어? 우리가 여기서 활동할 수 있는 건 눈에 안 띄어서야. 들키기라도 했으면
The Cursed One#138.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#139.src: But we weren't. I know the shift schedule of the guards, nobody was going to stop by while we were there.
The Cursed One#139.dst: 안 들켰잖아요. 경비병 교대 시간표를 알아요, 우리가 있을 땐 아무도 안 올 거였어요.
The Cursed One#139.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#140.src: ...sigh. You children, you'll be the death of me. Fine. You found the crystals, and you weren't spotted good.
The Cursed One#140.dst: ...하아. 너희 때문에 내가 못 산다. 좋아. 수정도 찾았고, 들키지도 않았으니 됐어.
The Cursed One#140.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#141.src: Um... not to interrupt, or, anything, but... I missed the c- magic. Could you... show us some more?
The Cursed One#141.dst: 음... 방해하려는 건, 아니, 아니지만... 나 그 ㅁ- 마법을 놓쳤어. 조금만... 더 보여 줄 수 있어?
The Cursed One#141.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#143.src: Indeed. Thank you for the demonstration, {u}. Now, we should
The Cursed One#143.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#144.src: Oh! Syndra, do- d- do you think you could show us something t- t- too? You're b- bl- blessed, so maybe it'd be
The Cursed One#144.dst: 아! Syndra, 너, 너도 뭐 좀 보, 보, 보여 줄 수 있어? 추, 축복받았으니까 아마
The Cursed One#144.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#146.src: ... O- o- okay! If- if you s- say- say so...
The Cursed One#146.dst: ... 아, 아, 알았어! 네가 그, 그렇게 말한다면...
The Cursed One#146.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#147.src: If we're done with the demonstrations, we should discuss
The Cursed One#147.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#148.src: But- b- but I want to tr- try now! I have a- a fo- focus, so I sh- should- I should be able to do... something.
The Cursed One#148.dst: 그, 그치만 지금 해 보고 싶어! 매, 매개체도 있으니까 뭐라도- 뭐라도 할 수 있을 거야.
The Cursed One#148.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#149.src: Sigh. Yes, alright, Zeph. But let me guide you through it, would you?
The Cursed One#149.dst: 하아. 그래, 알았어, Zeph. 대신 내가 이끌어 줄게, 알겠지?
The Cursed One#149.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#151.src: Take your position, Zeph. Everyone else, let's move out of the way.
The Cursed One#151.dst: 자리 잡아, Zeph. 다른 사람들은 비켜 서자.
The Cursed One#151.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#152.src: Yes, indeed, it would not do well for us to be injured, unintentionally or otherwise. Come on, Sui!
The Cursed One#152.dst: 그래요, 실수로든 뭐든 다치면 곤란하죠. 가자, Sui!
The Cursed One#152.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#153.src: And we're sure this is safe?
The Cursed One#153.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#154.src: We have all seen {u} in action, and they appear to be unharmed, no?
The Cursed One#154.dst: {u}이(가) 싸우는 걸 다들 봤지만 멀쩡해 보이잖아요?
The Cursed One#154.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#155.src: Okay, sure, but what if someone sees? It's not like we're especially hidden here.
The Cursed One#155.dst: 네, 그렇다 쳐도 누가 보면요? 여기가 딱히 숨겨진 곳도 아니잖아요.
The Cursed One#155.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#156.src: You know as well as I that the only ones showing up in these parts are outcasts and drunks!
The Cursed One#156.dst: 이 근방에 나타나는 건 추방자랑 술꾼뿐이라는 걸 당신도 나만큼 알잖아요!
The Cursed One#156.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#157.src: In any case, we can make it quick. Zeph, are you ready?
The Cursed One#157.dst: 어쨌든 빨리 끝내면 돼. Zeph, 준비됐어?
The Cursed One#157.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#159.src: Close your eyes, and hold the crystal close to your chest. Concentrate on the points of contact. Your hands, your chest. Do you feel anything?
The Cursed One#159.dst: 눈을 감고, 수정을 가슴에 꼭 대. 닿아 있는 곳에 집중해. 두 손, 가슴. 뭔가 느껴져?
The Cursed One#159.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#160.src: ...oh! I- I do! It's l- l- like... st- static electricity, li- little sparks bouncing around...
The Cursed One#160.dst: ...오! 느, 느껴져! 마, 마치... 정, 정전기 같아, 작은 불꽃이 튀어 다녀...
The Cursed One#160.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#161.src: Good. Now, you'll try to draw your focus inwards. Imagine the sparks being pulled towards the center of your body. Feel them gathering together.
The Cursed One#161.dst: 좋아. 이제 집중을 안으로 끌어모아 봐. 불꽃이 몸 한가운데로 끌려온다고 상상해. 그게 모이는 걸 느껴.
The Cursed One#161.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#163.src: Now, finally, try releasing that energy. Concentrate on the crystal again, the points of contact. Imagine pushing the sparks back into it, and then further, sending them out through the crystal
The Cursed One#163.dst: 이제 마지막으로 그 기운을 내보내 봐. 다시 수정에, 닿은 곳에 집중해. 불꽃을 수정 안으로 밀어 넣고, 더 멀리, 수정을 통해 내보낸다고 상상해
The Cursed One#163.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#164.dst: 아, 아! 바, 방금- 방금 그건...
The Cursed One#164.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#165.src: Hey! Are you okay? Not hurt? I don't see anything visible, but
The Cursed One#165.dst: 야! 괜찮아? 안 다쳤어? 눈에 띄는 건 없는데, 그래도
The Cursed One#165.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#166.src: W- would you s- st- stop, already? I'm fine!
The Cursed One#166.dst: 이, 이제 그, 그만 좀 할래? 나 괜찮아!
The Cursed One#166.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#167.src: Ow! What- wh- what was that for?!
The Cursed One#167.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#169.src: Well done, Zeph. You've done just as well as any of the soldiers I've seen receive blessings. Just... as well...
The Cursed One#169.dst: 잘했어, Zeph. 내가 본, 축복받은 병사 누구 못지않게 잘했어. 누구... 못지않게...
The Cursed One#169.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#170.src: ...was it really that easy all this time?
The Cursed One#170.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#172.src: Yes... yes, I'm alright. {u}, I apologize for doubting you. It would seem... you were right all along.
The Cursed One#172.dst: 그래... 그래요, 괜찮아요. {u}, 의심해서 미안해요. 보아하니... 당신 말이 처음부터 맞았네요.
The Cursed One#172.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#175.src: Sorry! Sorry. No, you're right. It was... cool, I guess. It's just... weird.
The Cursed One#175.dst: 죄송해요! 죄송해요. 아니, 맞는 말이에요. 멋지긴... 했죠. 그냥... 이상해요.
The Cursed One#175.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#176.src: A- a little, I guess. But if f- f- felt right. Like- l- like I always co- could have done it. Even if it was just sp- spark- sparkles.
The Cursed One#176.dst: 조, 조금은. 근데 느, 느, 느낌이 딱 맞았어. 마, 마치 늘 할 수 이, 있었던 것처럼. 그냥 반, 반짝이였어도.
The Cursed One#176.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#177.src: That's part of the process. You'll need a proper focus to do more... specially-forged weapons have always done the trick, in my experience.
The Cursed One#177.dst: 그것도 과정이야. 더 하려면 제대로 된 매개체가 필요해... 내 경험상 특별히 벼린 무기면 늘 통했어.
The Cursed One#177.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#178.src: Specially-forged weapons, you say? Miss, is there anything in particular one would need to create one? With the right materials, I'm certain I could forge Zeph what he needs.
The Cursed One#178.dst: 특별히 벼린 무기라고요? 아가씨, 그걸 만들려면 특별히 필요한 게 있나요? 재료만 맞으면 Zeph에게 필요한 걸 벼려 줄 자신이 있어요.
The Cursed One#178.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#179.src: A- a new weapon? That I ca- can cast ma- magic with?
The Cursed One#179.dst: 새, 새 무기? 마, 마법을 쓸 수 있는?
The Cursed One#179.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#180.src: I could see it coming in use. We'll want more sturdy materials than usual- preferably something that is magical in and of itself... Zeph, do you think you could-
The Cursed One#180.dst: 쓸모가 있겠네요. 평소보다 튼튼한 재료가 필요해요- 되도록 그 자체로 마법을 지닌 걸로... Zeph, 네가 혹시-
The Cursed One#180.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#181.src: Yes!!! I- I mean, uh, y- yes, I can do that.
The Cursed One#181.dst: 응!!! 그, 그러니까, 어, 으, 응, 할 수 있어.
The Cursed One#181.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#182.src: ...Okay! {u}, I kn- I- I know where to start! Me- meet me by the big tree to the n- nor- northeast! The one for the riddle!
The Cursed One#182.dst: ...좋아! {u}, 어디, 어- 어디서 시작할지 알아! 부, 북, 북동쪽 큰 나무 옆에서 만, 만나! 수수께끼 그 나무!
The Cursed One#182.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#183.src: Head to the big tree and find Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#184.src: I suppose I should get around to firing up the forge... Sui, will you need me for anything?
The Cursed One#184.dst: 슬슬 대장간 불을 피워야겠군요... Sui, 나한테 부탁할 거 있니?
The Cursed One#184.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#185.src: Um... n-no, I don't think so.
The Cursed One#185.dst: 음... 아, 아니, 없는 것 같아.
The Cursed One#185.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#186.src: He's taken to it remarkably well, hasn't he? Better than I could have hoped.
The Cursed One#186.dst: 놀랄 만큼 잘 적응하죠? 기대 이상이에요.
The Cursed One#186.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#187.src: {u}... you have opened a path for me that I never could have imagined. Thank you.
The Cursed One#187.dst: {u}... 상상도 못 한 길을 열어 줬어요. 고마워요.
The Cursed One#187.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#192.src: Never in my life did I expect to have my whole world view challenged, hoh!
The Cursed One#192.dst: 평생 내 세계관 전체가 흔들릴 줄은 몰랐어요, 호오!
The Cursed One#192.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#193.src: Admittedly, this information will take some time to progress...
The Cursed One#193.dst: 솔직히 이 정보를 소화하려면 시간이 좀 걸리겠어요...
The Cursed One#193.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#194.src: I'll most likely seek you out later with some follow up questions.
The Cursed One#194.dst: 나중에 추가로 물어볼 게 생기면 찾아갈게요.
The Cursed One#194.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#195.src: ...well, Synny, don't suppose any of this changes your usual approach?
The Cursed One#195.dst: ...그래, Synny, 이걸로 평소 방식이 달라지진 않겠지?
The Cursed One#195.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#196.src: Sigh... You know it does, Kaio. If there's a possibility more of our members could wield magic, then...
The Cursed One#196.dst: 하아... 달라지는 거 알잖아, Kaio. 우리 사람들이 더 마법을 쓸 수 있다면, 그럼...
The Cursed One#196.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#198.src: ... I don't know. I don't know if it'll work, yet.
The Cursed One#198.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#200.dst: 넌 맘에 드는 게 없잖아, Kaio.
The Cursed One#200.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#201.src: Yes, well, I especially don't like this. Don't like the ideas you're gettin' all up there in your head. It's a risk.
The Cursed One#201.dst: 그래, 뭐, 이건 특히 맘에 안 들어. 네 머릿속에 떠오르는 그 생각들이 맘에 안 들어. 위험한 짓이야.
The Cursed One#201.speaker: Kaio

The Cursed One#202.src: Everything is a risk. But it doesn't matter yet. It'll depend on what Quill has to tell me during the festival.
The Cursed One#202.dst: 다 위험하지. 그래도 아직은 상관없어. 축제 때 Quill이 뭘 전해 주느냐에 달렸어.
The Cursed One#202.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#204.src: When I m- ma- when I make my weapon... do you think I'll be a- a- able to cast real spells? And not just... poofs of sp- s- sparkles?
The Cursed One#204.dst: 내가 무, 무- 무기를 만들면... 진짜 주문을 쓸 수 이, 이, 있을까? 그냥... 퐁 하는 반, 반, 반짝이 말고?
The Cursed One#204.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#207.src: Sigh... I was h- h- hoping that- that- that I could do... I- I don't know! Something! A- any- anything to help. But... you're right.
The Cursed One#207.dst: 하아... 난 그, 그, 그래도 뭔가- 뭔가- 뭔가 할 수 있길... 나, 나도 몰라! 뭐든! 아, 아무거나 돕는 거. 근데... 네 말이 맞아.
The Cursed One#207.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#208.src: Oh. O- okay! That means it- it m- might help me, too. Thank you.
The Cursed One#208.dst: 아. 아, 알았어! 그럼 그, 그게 나한테도 도움이 될지 몰라. 고마워.
The Cursed One#208.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#209.src: Oh! R- ri- right! Well, Syndra said we sh- should find something magical, right? Well, I- I don't know for- f- for sure if it's magical or not, but...
The Cursed One#209.dst: 아! 마, 맞다! Syndra가 마법 있는 걸 차, 찾으라고 했잖아? 근데 이게 마법이 있는지 화, 확실히는 모르지만...
The Cursed One#209.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#210.src: A long, long time ago, th- this- this tree was more than just a stump! It had long arms st- str- stretching out over the whole forest, watching over th- the people and w- wi- wildlife.
The Cursed One#210.dst: 아주, 아주 먼 옛날, 이, 이- 이 나무는 그냥 그루터기가 아니었어! 긴 팔을 숲 전체에 뻗, 뻗, 뻗어서 사람들과 야, 야생 동물을 지켜봤대.
The Cursed One#210.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#211.src: When anyone was hurt, o- or- or unwell, the tree would reach out with its br- branches and grow fruit- fruit that was said to he- h- heal all injuries and illnesses.
The Cursed One#211.dst: 누가 다치거나, 아, 아- 아프면 나무가 가, 가지를 뻗어 열매를 맺었어- 모든 상처와 병을 치, 치- 치유한다는 열매를.
The Cursed One#211.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#212.src: It took care of the people, and the p- people took care of the tree. But then- then the c- cur- curse took hold of the people.
The Cursed One#212.dst: 나무는 사람을 돌보고, 사, 사람은 나무를 돌봤어. 그런데- 그런데 저, 저주가 사람들을 사로잡았지.
The Cursed One#212.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#213.src: In the chaos and d- des- destruction caused by the cursed ones, the tree was hurt. It stopped gr- grow- growing its gifts, and went to sleep... f- forever.
The Cursed One#213.dst: 저주받은 자들이 일으킨 혼란과 파, 파괴 속에서 나무는 다쳤어. 선, 선- 선물을 더는 맺지 않고 잠들었지... 여, 영원히.
The Cursed One#213.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#214.src: Even after the Queen arrived a- and blessed the people, the tree di- didn't- didn't wake up. Its trust had been broken...
The Cursed One#214.dst: 여왕이 와서 사람들에게 축복을 내린 뒤에도 나무는 깨, 깨지- 깨지 않았어. 믿음이 깨져 버렸거든...
The Cursed One#214.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#215.src: Ev- even though it's just a story... I hope s- some- someday the tree can trust us again. We could- c- could- we could really use its help, these days...
The Cursed One#215.dst: 그, 그냥 이야기일 뿐이지만... 어, 언젠가 나무가 다시 우릴 믿어 주면 좋겠어. 요즘 우리한텐 그, 그- 그 도움이 정말 필요하거든...
The Cursed One#215.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#216.src: ... A- a- anyway! The cavern you met Syndra in is also said to be s- sa- sacred. And the feel of the crystals reminds me of h- how I feel there.
The Cursed One#216.dst: ... 아, 아, 아무튼! 네가 Syndra를 만난 동굴도 시, 신성하다고 해. 수정의 느낌이 거기서 받는 느낌이랑 비슷해.
The Cursed One#216.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#217.src: So- s- so if we can find our way into the tree... we co- could find some m- ma- s- some magical wood. Follow me!
The Cursed One#217.dst: 그, 그러니까 나무 안으로 들어갈 길을 찾으면... 마, 마법이 깃든 나무를 찾을지도 몰라. 따라와!
The Cursed One#217.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#218.src: Head to the top of the giant tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#219.src: Hey! F- faster than last time! Keep up the im- im- improvement, and maybe soon I'll have to put in mo- more than {~}!
The Cursed One#219.dst: 야! 저, 저번보다 빨라! 계속 시, 실력이 늘면 곧 {~}보다 더 버, 벌려야겠는데!
The Cursed One#219.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#220.src: Ha... yeah... Um, earlier you m- me- mentioned that magic can be found in- in everything.
The Cursed One#220.dst: 하... 응... 음, 아까 마법은 모, 모든 것에- 모든 것에 있다고 했지.
The Cursed One#220.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#221.src: So... so ma- maybe we didn't need to come to- to- to this old tree... But- b- but it feels right to me.
The Cursed One#221.dst: 그러니까... 굳이 이, 이, 이 고목까지 올 필요는 없었을지도... 그, 그치만 나한텐 이게 맞는 것 같아.
The Cursed One#221.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#222.src: ... Thank you for c- c- coming along.
The Cursed One#222.dst: ... 같이 와, 와, 와 줘서 고마워.
The Cursed One#222.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#223.src: It's a breath of fresh air, having someone n- n- new around! I don't know, having you around just f- fe- feels... good! Like- like anything is possible!
The Cursed One#223.dst: 새, 새, 새로운 사람이 곁에 있으니 숨통이 트여! 모르겠어, 네가 있으면 그냥 느, 느낌이... 좋아! 뭐든- 뭐든 가능할 것 같아!
The Cursed One#223.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#224.src: ... Oh, I- I- I'm getting too sappy. Sorry, sorry!
The Cursed One#224.dst: ... 아, 나, 나, 너무 감상적이다. 미안, 미안!
The Cursed One#224.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#225.src: Well... my h- h- my heart is telling me that this wood is what I w- w- what I want!
The Cursed One#225.dst: 음... 내 마, 마, 내 마음이 이 나무가 내가 워, 원- 원하는 거래!
The Cursed One#225.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#226.src: That old tale... it's one of the o- o- only things I still remember from my childhood.
The Cursed One#226.dst: 그 옛날이야기는... 어릴 적 일 중에 아, 아, 아직 기억나는 몇 안 되는 거야.
The Cursed One#226.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#227.src: So, s- so this is definitely what I want my w- we- weapon to be made out of.
The Cursed One#227.dst: 그, 그러니까 내 무, 무기는 꼭 이걸로 만들고 싶어.
The Cursed One#227.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#228.src: Oh... y- y- yeah. Maybe you're right...
The Cursed One#228.dst: 아... 그, 그, 그래. 네 말이 맞을지도...
The Cursed One#228.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#229.src: I just thought... choosing s- some- something special to me would- would be b- best.
The Cursed One#229.dst: 그냥... 나한테 트, 특별한- 특별한 걸 고르는 게 제, 제일 좋을 것 같았어.
The Cursed One#229.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#230.src: B- but we're here now any- a- anyway, aren't we? So we can just use the- the- the wood here...
The Cursed One#230.dst: 그, 그래도 어, 어쨌든 이미 왔잖아? 그러니까 그냥 여, 여, 여기 나무를 쓰면 돼...
The Cursed One#230.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#231.src: So, we've gotta find a way into the tr- the tree...
The Cursed One#231.dst: 그럼, 나무 안으로 들어갈 길을 찾아야 해...
The Cursed One#231.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#232.src: Ha, I- I'm not exactly a wood- woodcutting expert... maybe it'd have been smart to ask Mora t- to- to join us?
The Cursed One#232.dst: 하, 나 벌, 벌목 전문가도 아닌데... Mora한테 가, 같이- 같이 가자고 할 걸 그랬나?
The Cursed One#232.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#233.src: ... Do- do you have any ideas? May- maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#233.dst: ... 무, 무슨 생각 있어? 어, 어쩌면 주, 주, 주문으로 뚫을 수 있지 않을까?
The Cursed One#233.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#234.src: Cast a spell ontop of the tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#235.src: Maybe you could break through with a sp- spe- spell?
The Cursed One#235.dst: 어쩌면 주, 주, 주문으로 뚫을 수 있지 않을까?
The Cursed One#235.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#237.src: ... Do- do you think the t- tr- the tree heard me earlier? Is it...
The Cursed One#237.dst: ... 나, 나무가 아까 내 말을 드, 들, 들은 걸까? 설마...
The Cursed One#237.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#238.src: This- th- this has to be a sign! Come on, let's go in!
The Cursed One#238.dst: 이, 이- 이건 분명 신호야! 가자, 들어가자!
The Cursed One#238.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#239.src: Find the wood Zeph wants at the end of the root system.
The Cursed One#239.dst: 뿌리 끝에서 Zeph가 원하는 나무를 찾으세요.

The Cursed One#240.src: Th- th- there! That should- sh- should be a big enough chunk for Mora... right?
The Cursed One#240.dst: 저, 저, 저기! Mora한테 저 정도면 충, 충분히 크겠지... 그렇지?
The Cursed One#240.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#241.src: A- and- you're still not fast enough to beat me to th- th- to the end!
The Cursed One#241.dst: 그, 그리고- 넌 아직도 끄, 끄, 끝까지 날 못 따라잡네!
The Cursed One#241.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#242.src: Okay, next... We- weapons are usually made of m- me- metal, right? That's why Mora has a f- fo- a forge.
The Cursed One#242.dst: 좋아, 다음은... 무, 무기는 보통 그, 금속으로 만들지? 그래서 Mora한테 대, 대, 대장간이 있고.
The Cursed One#242.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#243.src: ...I have a- an- an idea! Let's meet up near {p}, wh- where we first met.
The Cursed One#243.dst: ...조, 좋은- 좋은 생각이 났어! {p} 근처, 우, 우리가 처음 만난 데서 보자.
The Cursed One#243.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#245.src: O- okay, so. The crown usually uses t- ti- titanium for their equipment. Th- that's what Mora says, at least.
The Cursed One#245.dst: 자, 좋아. 왕실은 보통 장비에 티, 티타늄을 써. 저, 적어도 Mora 말로는.
The Cursed One#245.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#246.src: But- b- but, it can be hard to come by, b- be- because the crown keeps most of it for themselves.
The Cursed One#246.dst: 그, 그, 그치만 구하기 어려워. 와, 왕실이 대부분 자기들이 가지고 있으니까.
The Cursed One#246.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#247.src: Luckily, it's F- F- Festival time, so a bunch of m- merchants are in town! And they're fr- from all over the p- pr- province, not just here!
The Cursed One#247.dst: 다행히 지금은 추, 추, 축제 기간이라 사, 상인이 잔뜩 와 있어! 여기뿐 아니라 지, 지방 곳곳에서 왔고!
The Cursed One#247.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#248.src: So someone m- must have titanium, somewhere... we'll j- just- just have to look around.
The Cursed One#248.dst: 그러니 누군가는 티타늄이 이, 있을 거야... 그, 그냥- 그냥 둘러보면 돼.
The Cursed One#248.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#249.src: Ah! Th- that- that's the Sovereign!
The Cursed One#249.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#250.src: ...and alongside that, does she really think it's safe to hold the festival right now, sir? That opens up a really big risk!
The Cursed One#250.dst: ...그리고 그것과 별개로, 여왕님은 정말 지금 축제를 여는 게 안전하다고 보시나요, 군주님? 엄청 큰 위험이에요!
The Cursed One#250.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#251.src: What do you th- th- think they're t- talking about? Come on, let- l- let's shadow them.
The Cursed One#251.dst: 무슨 얘, 얘, 얘기 하는 걸까? 가자, 따, 따, 따라가 보자.
The Cursed One#251.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#252.src: If the cursed thinks they can get past both myself and Her Majesty, they're out of their vector. You don't need to worry about the people.
The Cursed One#252.dst: 그 저주받은 자가 나랑 여왕 폐하를 둘 다 넘을 수 있다고 생각하면, 벡터를 한참 잘못 잡은 거지. 백성 걱정은 안 해도 돼.
The Cursed One#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#253.src: I was more worried about... ...um... W-well, never mind that! If you think we'll all be safe, sir, I'll take you at your word!
The Cursed One#253.dst: 제가 걱정한 건 사실... ...음... 그, 그냥 신경 쓰지 마세요! 모두 안전할 거라고 보신다면, 군주님 말씀을 믿을게요!
The Cursed One#253.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#254.src: Let me rephrase- you don't need to worry about anyone. ...heh. Any- wait. What's that noise?
The Cursed One#254.dst: 다시 말하지- 넌 누구도 걱정할 필요 없어. ...흠. 누구- 잠깐. 저 소리 뭐지?
The Cursed One#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#255.src: Just someone out on a random walk? Back to the point is everything for the festival shaping up according to schedule?
The Cursed One#255.dst: 그냥 누가 랜덤 워크 중인가? 본론으로 돌아가서 축제 준비는 전부 일정대로 되고 있나?
The Cursed One#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#256.src: Oh yes! Yes it is, sir! The vendors have all been assigned, the game stands have all been constructed, we've commissioned a local band... The one you liked last year!
The Cursed One#256.dst: 네, 그럼요! 그렇습니다, 군주님! 노점상 배정도 끝났고, 게임 가판대도 다 세웠고, 지역 악단도 섭외했어요... 작년에 좋아하신 그 악단이요!
The Cursed One#256.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#257.src: Golden. That rendition of "CHASE" is what really sold me on them.
The Cursed One#257.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#258.src: That just leaves your speech, sir! Have you Oh, who am I kidding, you already have it memorized.
The Cursed One#258.dst: 그럼 연설만 남았네요, 군주님! 혹시 아, 제가 무슨 소리를, 벌써 다 외우셨죠.
The Cursed One#258.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#259.src: Naturally, Xao. We have the whole festival set down to the last point, it looks like. Any more business to factor out?
The Cursed One#259.dst: 물론이지, Xao. 보아하니 축제는 소수점 끝자리까지 다 정해졌군. 더 인수분해할 안건 있나?
The Cursed One#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#260.src: Yes, sir! I've received word that Inquisitor Renn will be arriving tonight, as you sent me to request for!
The Cursed One#260.dst: 네, 군주님! 요청하라고 보내신 대로, Renn 심문관이 오늘 밤 도착한다는 전갈을 받았어요!
The Cursed One#260.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#261.src: Fantastic job. I have to remember that the Inquisitors aren't like me. When they're busy they can't just go triple-time... Still, good to have that problem solved.
The Cursed One#261.dst: 훌륭해. 심문관들은 나랑 다르다는 걸 기억해야지. 바쁠 때 그냥 3배속으로 뛸 수가 없거든... 그래도 그 문제가 풀렸으니 잘됐어.
The Cursed One#261.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#262.src: You know, they should check your work. This is proof positive they can keep pace with me like you can.
The Cursed One#262.dst: 있잖아, 그쪽은 네 풀이를 검산해 봐야 해. 이게 그쪽도 너처럼 내 속도를 따라올 수 있다는 확실한 증명이야.
The Cursed One#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#263.src: Well! Sir! You know I've had to insist you stop and rest sometimes, and Inquisitors do serve the whole of the province, so...
The Cursed One#263.dst: 어머! 군주님! 제가 가끔 좀 쉬시라고 우겨야 하는 거 아시잖아요, 게다가 심문관은 지방 전체를 위해 일하니까...
The Cursed One#263.speaker: Xao

The Cursed One#264.src: Hmm... ev- even with us r- r- raiding Nixeph, he isn't concerned...
The Cursed One#264.dst: 흠... 우, 우리가 Nixeph를 스, 스, 습격했는데도 걱정을 안 하네...
The Cursed One#264.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#265.src: A- and- an Inquisitor! Th- that- that's not good. We need to tell the others to be c- ca- careful...
The Cursed One#265.dst: 게, 게다가- 심문관이라니! 이, 이- 이건 안 좋아. 다들 조, 조심하라고 알려야 해...
The Cursed One#265.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#266.src: Oh! R- r- right! You're not from here. They're, uh, b- b- bad news. They're sent to d- d- deal with... um, c- cursed ones, and other s- si- similar stuff.
The Cursed One#266.dst: 아! 마, 마, 맞다! 넌 여기 사람이 아니지. 걔들은, 어, 아, 아, 아주 골칫거리야. 저, 저주받은 자 같은 걸 처, 처리하러 보, 보내지는 사람들이야.
The Cursed One#266.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#267.src: If one's a- around... we have to b- be careful. But, since w- we- since we're here, we should still find the t- ti- titanium.
The Cursed One#267.dst: 하나라도 그, 근처에 있으면... 조심해야 해. 그래도 우, 우리- 이왕 왔으니까 티, 티타늄은 찾아야지.
The Cursed One#267.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#268.src: There's a b- b- bazaar in the tunnel... if anyone wi- will have it, they'll be there.
The Cursed One#268.dst: 터널 안에 시, 시, 시장이 있어... 누가 가, 가지고 있다면 거기일 거야.
The Cursed One#268.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#270.src: Fine quality metals, fine quality metals for- Ah, hello, hello! Might you be interested in my stock, friends?
The Cursed One#270.dst: 질 좋은 금속, 질 좋은 금속 팝- 아, 안녕하세요, 안녕하세요! 제 물건에 관심 있으신가요, 친구분들?
The Cursed One#270.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#271.src: I've got all sorts for sale. Ingots, pre-made bangles and bracelets and trinkets I've got hold of this lovely iron leaf, in fact. Quite fine decor, I might think!
The Cursed One#271.dst: 온갖 걸 팔아요. 주괴, 이미 만든 팔찌와 뱅글, 장신구 사실 이 멋진 철 잎사귀도 손에 넣었죠. 꽤 괜찮은 장식품 같아요!
The Cursed One#271.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#272.src: Hello! We're a- ac- actually looking for titanium! Would you h- ha- happen to have any in stock?
The Cursed One#272.dst: 안녕하세요! 사, 사실 티타늄을 찾고 있어요! 혹, 혹시 재고 있으세요?
The Cursed One#272.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#273.src: Aha, you're in luck then! I've managed to obtain some from a passing {p} merchant! Straight from the {p} and so I'm told, quite good quality!
The Cursed One#273.dst: 아하, 그럼 운이 좋으시네요! 지나가던 {p} 상인에게서 좀 구했거든요! {p}에서 바로 온 거고 듣기로는 품질도 꽤 좋대요!
The Cursed One#273.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#274.src: I think the man was struck dumb by the offer of leaves I handed in return, he left with such a bewildered face- but I digress! Would you like ingots, or anything pre-hewn?
The Cursed One#274.dst: 대가로 잎을 건넸더니 그 사람 말문이 막혔나 봐요, 어리둥절한 얼굴로 떠나더라니까요- 아무튼 각설하고! 주괴로 드릴까요, 가공품으로 드릴까요?
The Cursed One#274.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#275.src: Uh... just- j- just some ingots would be fine.
The Cursed One#275.dst: 어... 그, 그냥 주괴 몇 개면 돼요.
The Cursed One#275.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#276.src: Indeed, then! It is always fine to see those interested in the crafting trades. For this, I might say ten Liff Leaves would be an agreeable price, yes?
The Cursed One#276.dst: 그러시죠! 공예에 관심 있는 분을 보면 늘 반가워요. 이 정도면 Liff 잎 열 장이 적당한 값일 것 같은데, 어때요?
The Cursed One#276.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#277.src: Ten!? Oh, f- fine... you said it's h- high- high quality? It's pr- probably worth the price. Here.
The Cursed One#277.dst: 열 장!? 아, 조, 좋아요... 품, 품질이 좋다고 하셨죠? 아, 아마 그만한 값은 하겠죠. 여기요.
The Cursed One#277.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#278.src: Indeed, friend, so I have been assured! May you have fine fortune in your endeavors!
The Cursed One#278.dst: 그럼요, 친구분, 확실히 보증받았답니다! 하시는 일에 행운이 깃들길!
The Cursed One#278.speaker: Metal Merchant

The Cursed One#280.src: Hm... I d- don't- I don't think titanium is meant to have th- these purple streaks...
The Cursed One#280.dst: 흠... 티타늄에 이, 이런 보라색 줄무늬가 있어야 하는 건- 아닌 것 같은데...
The Cursed One#280.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#281.src: But I- I- I'm not the blacksmith, so... a- a- and it's not like anyone else is s- se- selling titanium, so.
The Cursed One#281.dst: 그치만 나, 나, 난 대장장이가 아니니까... 그, 그리고 티타늄 파, 파는 사람도 달리 없으니까.
The Cursed One#281.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#282.src: Huh? Oh, r- r- right, I keep forgetting you don't know e- ev- everything around here.
The Cursed One#282.dst: 응? 아, 마, 맞다, 넌 여기 일을 다, 다 모른다는 걸 자꾸 잊어.
The Cursed One#282.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#283.src: The Auburn F- Fo- Forest may be a poorer area, so we d- do- don't have many emeralds...
The Cursed One#283.dst: Auburn 숲은 가, 가난한 지역이라 에메랄드가 마, 많지 않아...
The Cursed One#283.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#284.src: But we make up for it by u- u- using all the varied m- materials from the forest! People here v- val- value things from the wild more than e- em- emeralds.
The Cursed One#284.dst: 대신 숲의 온갖 재, 재, 재료를 써서 메워! 여기 사람들은 에, 에메랄드보다 야생에서 난 걸 더 가, 가치 있게 여겨.
The Cursed One#284.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#285.src: Liff Leaves especially are in high d- d- demand due to their versatility.
The Cursed One#285.dst: 특히 Liff 잎은 쓰임새가 많아서 수, 수, 수요가 높아.
The Cursed One#285.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#286.src: You don't need a- an- anything else? Then I'm r- ready to go.
The Cursed One#286.dst: 다른 건 피, 필요 없어? 그럼 난 주, 준비됐어.
The Cursed One#286.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#287.src: Want to tr- travel back with me?
The Cursed One#287.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#289.src: Okay! I'll m- m- meet you later, then.
The Cursed One#289.dst: 알았어! 그럼 나중에 마, 마, 만나.
The Cursed One#289.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#290.src: Return to the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#292.src: Ah! Good, you're just in time.
The Cursed One#292.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#293.src: Uh... in time for wh- what? A- and- and where is everybody?
The Cursed One#293.dst: 어... 뭐, 뭐에 맞춰? 그, 그리고- 다들 어디 갔어?
The Cursed One#293.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#294.src: Have you forgotten? The Festival of the Queen is about to start!
The Cursed One#294.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#295.src: Wh- th- that was today?! Oh, man, I g- g- got so excited about the m- m- the ma- magic... I forgot!
The Cursed One#295.dst: 그, 그게 오늘이었어?! 이런, 마, 마, 마법에 너무 들, 들떠서... 까먹었어!
The Cursed One#295.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#296.src: Wait... w- wait, before I go Syndra, we o- ov- overheard something in town. The S- S- Sovereign said an In- Inquisitor would be arriving t- t- tonight!
The Cursed One#296.dst: 잠깐... 자, 잠깐, 가기 전에 Syndra, 마을에서 뭘 어, 엿들었어. 구, 군주가 오, 오늘 밤 시, 심문관이 온다고 했어!
The Cursed One#296.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#297.src: ...ah. Well, that pushes ahead our timeline significantly...
The Cursed One#297.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#298.src: Hopefully, they're just here to clear out that cave you found the crystals in, but... better to be safe than sorry.
The Cursed One#298.dst: 수정을 찾은 그 동굴을 치우러 오는 거면 좋겠지만... 조심해서 나쁠 건 없지.
The Cursed One#298.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#299.src: That can wait until after the festival, though. You should go on ahead an enjoy yourself.
The Cursed One#299.dst: 그래도 그건 축제 끝나고 해도 돼. 먼저 가서 즐기고 와.
The Cursed One#299.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#300.src: ...if you s- s- say so, Syndra. {u}, you should c- come to the festival too! See you there!
The Cursed One#300.dst: ...네가 그, 그, 그렇게 말한다면, Syndra. {u}, 너도 축제에 와! 거기서 봐!
The Cursed One#300.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#301.src: Ah... there he goes. Well, what do you say? Will you join us for the festival?
The Cursed One#301.dst: 아... 가 버렸네. 자, 어때요? 우리랑 같이 축제에 갈래요?
The Cursed One#301.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#302.src: It is a celebration of the crown... but you have a limited time here, and it is still a part of our culture. You wouldn't want to miss it.
The Cursed One#302.dst: 왕실을 기리는 행사지만... 여기 있을 시간이 한정돼 있고, 그래도 우리 문화의 일부예요. 놓치면 아쉬울 거예요.
The Cursed One#302.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#303.src: It's a day for everyone to relax and enjoy themselves. The children certainly do... it's good for them, I think, to have some normalcy.
The Cursed One#303.dst: 모두가 쉬고 즐기는 날이에요. 아이들은 확실히 그래요... 그 애들에게 평범한 하루가 있는 건 좋은 일이라고 생각해요.
The Cursed One#303.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#304.src: I'll finish packing some things here, then I'll head on over. You should meet me there. If you head south, the river will lead you right to it.
The Cursed One#304.dst: 여기 짐 좀 마저 싸고 갈게요. 거기서 만나요. 남쪽으로 가면 강이 바로 거기까지 이어져요.
The Cursed One#304.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#305.src: Join Syndra at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Cursed One#306.src: I'll head on over soon. I just need to take care of some things before I leave.
The Cursed One#306.dst: 곧 갈게요. 떠나기 전에 처리할 일이 좀 있어서요.
The Cursed One#306.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#307.src: You're here! Allow me to welcome you to the annual Festival of the Crown.
The Cursed One#307.dst: 왔군요! 해마다 열리는 왕관 축제에 온 걸 환영해요.
The Cursed One#307.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#308.src: I have some business to attend to, so Zeph, would you be able to show {u} around?
The Cursed One#308.dst: 볼일이 좀 있어서 그러는데, Zeph, {u}한테 여기저기 구경 좀 시켜 줄래?
The Cursed One#308.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#310.src: So there's some g- games over there... and right here is the f- foo- food and beverages s- s- stand!
The Cursed One#310.dst: 저쪽에 게임이 좀 있고... 바로 여기가 으, 음식이랑 음료 가, 가, 가판대야!
The Cursed One#310.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#311.src: They sell re- r- regional food and drinks. And, a- ac- according to Rex... they've even im- im- imported some fancy alcohol from the h- high- highlands!
The Cursed One#311.dst: 지역 음식이랑 술을 팔아. 그리고 Rex 마, 말로는... 고, 고지대에서 비싼 술까지 수, 수입했대!
The Cursed One#311.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#312.src: Here are some at- attractions, and an animal exhibit! I, uh, d- d- don't- I don't like the Mudkins game very much...
The Cursed One#312.dst: 여긴 노, 놀이 시설이랑 동물 전시장이야! 난, 어, 그, 그, Mudkin 게임은 별로 안 좋아해...
The Cursed One#312.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#313.src: I th- think I saw Sui back there, so... I'm gonna go h- ha- hang out with her. You sh- should check out some of the stalls!
The Cursed One#313.dst: 저, 저기 뒤에 Sui가 있었던 것 같아서... 가서 가, 같, 같이 놀려고. 너, 넌 노점들 좀 둘러봐!
The Cursed One#313.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#315.src: ...thank you, Jiro. It's always good to hear from
The Cursed One#315.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#317.src: Hm? Oh, that's just {u} they're who I was hoping to write to Quill about. {u}, this is Jiro, my contact from the Roughworks.
The Cursed One#317.dst: 응? 아, 그냥 {u}. Quill한테 편지로 알리려던 사람. {u}, 이쪽은 Jiro, Roughworks 쪽 연락책이에요.
The Cursed One#317.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#318.src: Ah. Well, it's good to meet you then.
The Cursed One#318.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#319.src: Quill is... an old friend. It can be hard for us to stay in contact... discretely... so we often send messages this way.
The Cursed One#319.dst: Quill은... 오랜 친구예요. 연락을... 조용히... 유지하기 어려워서, 이런 식으로 자주 소식을 전해요.
The Cursed One#319.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#320.src: Wasn't going to use my yearly rail pass for anything anyway, so might as well.
The Cursed One#320.dst: 어차피 연간 철도 패스 쓸 데도 없었으니, 뭐 이렇게라도.
The Cursed One#320.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#321.src: Well, it's more than I'm able to do, so I appreciate it. In any case, Quill runs his own... organization, shall we say.
The Cursed One#321.dst: 그래도 내가 할 수 있는 것보다 많으니 고마워. 아무튼 Quill은 자기만의... 조직을 운영해요, 말하자면.
The Cursed One#321.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#323.src: The Roughworks is the region directly to the south of here, just past the wall. Officially, it's known as the {p}.
The Cursed One#323.dst: Roughworks는 여기 바로 남쪽, 성벽 너머 지역이에요. 공식적으로는 {p}(이)라고 해요.
The Cursed One#323.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#324.src: I can fill you in on it later. This isn't the place for it.
The Cursed One#324.dst: 그건 나중에 알려 줄게요. 여기서 할 얘기는 아니에요.
The Cursed One#324.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#325.src: ...ahem. Should we get back to it then?
The Cursed One#325.speaker: Jiro

The Cursed One#326.src: We should. {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#326.dst: 그러자. {u}, 가판대 좀 둘러보고 나중에 다시 와요.
The Cursed One#326.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#327.src: {u}, take a look around the stalls and come back later.
The Cursed One#327.dst: {u}, 가판대 좀 둘러보고 나중에 다시 와요.
The Cursed One#327.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#329.src: You're here visiting too I see!
The Cursed One#329.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#330.src: I plan on touring the whole festival this year around. Next up for me is the {p}!
The Cursed One#330.dst: 올해는 축제를 한 바퀴 다 돌아볼 거예요. 다음 목적지는 {p}!
The Cursed One#330.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#331.src: But the Auburn festival is known for the best food and beverages around the province. Trust me! Those rumours are true.
The Cursed One#331.dst: 그래도 음식이랑 음료는 지방 통틀어 Auburn 축제가 최고로 유명해요. 믿어요! 소문이 사실이에요.
The Cursed One#331.speaker: Highlands Tourist

The Cursed One#332.src: Will that be enough boar meat, ma'am?
The Cursed One#332.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#333.src: Yes, dear. Thank you for always being so kind-hearted, helping us out each and every year.
The Cursed One#333.dst: 그럼, 얘야. 해마다 늘 마음 써서 도와줘서 고맙구나.
The Cursed One#333.speaker: Food Merchant

The Cursed One#334.src: No worries, Oya! Hope you sell... oh. It's you.
The Cursed One#334.dst: 별말씀을요, Oya! 잘 파시길... 아. 너구나.
The Cursed One#334.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#337.src: Huh? I'm just here with a delivery. Nothing much.
The Cursed One#337.dst: 응? 배달하러 온 것뿐이야. 별거 아니야.
The Cursed One#337.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#338.dst: ...으, 내가 왜 네 장단을 맞춰 주고 있지?!
The Cursed One#338.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#339.src: Just cause you've got everyone else wrapped around your finger, doesn't mean I have to be fine with you!
The Cursed One#339.dst: 다른 사람들을 다 손바닥 위에 올려놨다고, 나까지 네가 괜찮아야 하는 건 아니야!
The Cursed One#339.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#340.src: Everything was fine until you showed up. I- I- I'd gotten over it! I made a home here, and now- and now, you
The Cursed One#340.dst: 네가 나타나기 전엔 다 괜찮았어. 나- 나- 난 다 잊었었다고! 여기서 집을 꾸렸는데, 이제- 이제 네가
The Cursed One#340.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#341.src: And- and sure, I'm happy for Zeph, but your- your- your everything, it's got Syndra plotting, and- and we were safe, and you've ruined that.
The Cursed One#341.dst: 그래- 그래, Zeph 일은 기뻐. 근데 너의- 너의- 너의 전부가 Syndra를 꾸미게 만들고, 그- 우린 안전했는데, 네가 망쳤어.
The Cursed One#341.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#342.src: So... so, no, I don't have to be okay with you. I don't trust you, I don't trust where you're from, and I definitely don't trust your... your c
The Cursed One#342.dst: 그러니까... 그러니까, 아니, 난 네가 괜찮을 필요 없어. 난 널 못 믿어, 네가 온 곳도 못 믿고, 네 그... 그 저
The Cursed One#342.speaker: Rex

The Cursed One#345.src: Have you seen an- any- anyone else yet?
The Cursed One#345.dst: 다른 사람 아, 아, 아무라도 봤어?
The Cursed One#345.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#346.src: I was, um, looking for Mora... earlier. I, ah, didn't find him.
The Cursed One#346.dst: 난, 음, 아까... Mora를 찾고 있었어. 그, 못 찾았어.
The Cursed One#346.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#347.src: We, uh, s- saw Rex run past just a bit ago. Did s- so- something happen?
The Cursed One#347.dst: 우린, 어, 방, 방금 Rex가 뛰어가는 걸 봤어. 무, 무슨 일 있었어?
The Cursed One#347.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#348.src: I can... um, take a guess.
The Cursed One#348.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#349.src: An- anyway, how are you liking the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#349.dst: 아, 아무튼, 추, 축제는 마음에 들어?
The Cursed One#349.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#350.src: Hey, th- that's good to hear!
The Cursed One#350.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#351.src: Have you, um, had the chance to, to taste any of the food? From the... food stall?
The Cursed One#351.dst: 음, 음식은, 먹어 봤어? 그... 음식 가판대에서?
The Cursed One#351.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#352.src: Hahaha, as if th- th- there's any left after y- you- you ate so much!
The Cursed One#352.dst: 하하하, 네가 그, 그, 그렇게 먹어 치웠는데 남은 게 있겠냐!
The Cursed One#352.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#353.src: Okay... well, I, I was hungry! That's... not my fault.
The Cursed One#353.dst: 그래... 뭐, 배, 배고팠단 말이야! 그건... 내 잘못 아니야.
The Cursed One#353.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#354.src: Oh... finally, someone else who, um, who gets it.
The Cursed One#354.dst: 아... 드디어, 음, 이해하는 사람이 있네.
The Cursed One#354.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#355.src: Wh- wh- what?! Sui, you don't like the f- fes- festival?
The Cursed One#355.dst: 뭐, 뭐, 뭐?! Sui, 추, 축, 축제가 싫어?
The Cursed One#355.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#356.src: I- I didn't, say that. It's just... a little boring. There's, um, not much to do.
The Cursed One#356.dst: 그- 그렇게, 말은 안 했어. 그냥... 좀 지루해. 음, 할 게 별로 없어.
The Cursed One#356.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#357.src: There's good f- food, fun rides a- and- and games... okay, m- maybe except the Mudkin g- game...
The Cursed One#357.dst: 맛있는 으, 음식에 놀이기구, 게, 게- 게임도 있잖아... 그래, 아, 아마 Mudkin 게, 게임만 빼고...
The Cursed One#357.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#358.src: Why don't you, um, like the Mudkins? I... I think they're fun.
The Cursed One#358.dst: 넌 왜, 음, Mudkin이 싫어? 난... 재밌던데.
The Cursed One#358.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#359.src: They're s- s- so- there's no strategy! You j- just pick a random one, and- a- and sometimes you win!
The Cursed One#359.dst: 그건 너, 너, 너무- 전략이 없잖아! 그, 그냥 아무거나 고르면 가, 가끔 이기는 거야!
The Cursed One#359.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#361.src: Unbelievable. {u}, a- a- are you hearing this?
The Cursed One#361.dst: 말도 안 돼. {u}, 너, 너, 너 이거 들었어?
The Cursed One#361.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#362.src: Okay, wh- whatever... Sui, let's go t- try out the zipline. I wonder if th- th- they changed it this year.
The Cursed One#362.dst: 아, 알았어, 뭐, 뭐 어때... Sui, 짚라인 타러 가자. 올해 바, 바, 바뀌었나 궁금하네.
The Cursed One#362.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#363.src: ...could we, um, get food first? I'm hungry.
The Cursed One#363.dst: ...그 전에, 음, 뭐 좀 먹으면 안 돼? 배고파.
The Cursed One#363.speaker: Sui

The Cursed One#364.src: A- ag- again?! No, we should do the z- z- zipline first. I don't want you th- thr- throwing up all over me.
The Cursed One#364.dst: 또, 또?! 안 돼, 짚, 짚, 짚라인 먼저야. 나한테 토, 토, 토하는 건 싫어.
The Cursed One#364.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#366.src: You kn- know I'm right! Oh, uh, {u}, you can j- j- join us if you want! It's fun, I pr- promise.
The Cursed One#366.dst: 내 말 마, 맞잖아! 아, 어, {u}, 원하면 가, 가, 같이 가도 돼! 재밌어, 야, 약속해.
The Cursed One#366.speaker: Zeph

The Cursed One#368.src: The {p} orchestra is definitely the best in all of Fruma! Well, not that I've heard any other orchestras.
The Cursed One#368.dst: {p} 관현악단은 확실히 Fruma 최고야! 뭐, 다른 관현악단을 들어 본 적은 없지만.
The Cursed One#368.speaker: Festival Goer

The Cursed One#369.src: Aha! Hello there, {u}! Enjoying our festival, are you?
The Cursed One#369.dst: 아하! 안녕하세요, {u}! 우리 축제 즐기고 있나요?
The Cursed One#369.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#370.src: I trust you and Zeph have acquired all the necessary materials in the time since we last spoke?
The Cursed One#370.dst: 지난번 얘기 이후로 Zeph와 필요한 재료는 다 구했겠죠?
The Cursed One#370.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#371.src: As soon as the festival concludes, I shall get right to smithing. I have a good feeling about this one!
The Cursed One#371.dst: 축제가 끝나는 대로 바로 대장일에 들어갈게요. 이번 건 느낌이 좋아요!
The Cursed One#371.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#372.src: I, ah... am still learning. But I have greatly improved since I started, worry not!
The Cursed One#372.dst: 나, 아... 아직 배우는 중이에요. 그래도 처음보다 많이 늘었으니 걱정 마요!
The Cursed One#372.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#373.src: ...ehm. I suppose I should return to my report...
The Cursed One#373.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#374.src: Hm? Ah, yes, I forget this is your first year. First week, even.
The Cursed One#374.dst: 응? 아, 그렇죠, 올해가 처음이라는 걸 잊었네요. 첫 주이기도 하고요.
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#375.src: I am... gathering data. Recording the changes since last year's festival guard positioning and numbers, types of stands, amount of attendees and so on.
The Cursed One#375.dst: 자료를... 모으는 중이에요. 작년 축제 이후 바뀐 걸 기록하죠. 경비 배치와 인원, 가판대 종류, 참석자 수 같은 거요.
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#376.src: It is... perhaps unnecessarily thorough. Much of this data has not proven to be useful thus far... but it is something for me to do, and I do it well.
The Cursed One#376.dst: 아마... 쓸데없이 꼼꼼하겠죠. 이 자료 대부분은 아직 쓸모가 증명되지 않았지만... 내가 할 수 있는 일이고, 잘하는 일이니까요.
The Cursed One#376.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#377.src: These festivals... I suppose our discomfort is something Syndra and I share. It can be hard for us to enjoy ourselves, knowing what we do.
The Cursed One#377.dst: 이런 축제는... 그 불편함은 Syndra와 내가 같이 느끼는 거겠죠. 우리가 아는 걸 알고 나면 즐기기가 어려워요.
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#378.src: I am grateful that the younger Leaves can still find joy here. Perhaps you might as well, given your... relative lack of history.
The Cursed One#378.dst: 어린 잎새들이 아직 여기서 즐거움을 찾을 수 있어 다행이에요. 당신도 그럴지 모르죠, 비교적... 얽힌 과거가 없으니.
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#379.src: Ah, but I am rambling. If you will excuse me, I need to get back to... counting all the new food items... hm.
The Cursed One#379.dst: 아, 말이 길어졌네요. 실례지만 난 돌아가서... 새 음식 품목을 전부 세야 해서요... 흠.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Mora

The Cursed One#380.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#381.src: Perhaps you would like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#383.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#383.dst: 찻잎 원료랑 갓 우린 차를 둘 다 팔아요.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#384.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#384.dst: 숲이 내어 주는 최고의 재료에 대해 역사 수업을 해 드릴게요.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#385.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#385.dst: Auburn에서는 차가 아주 인기라, 사람들이 찾을 수 있는 거의 모든 식물로 차를 만들어 냈어요! 어떤 건... 다른 것보다 맛있죠.
The Cursed One#385.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#386.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from a bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#386.dst: 예를 들면 영지버섯이요! 버섯만으로 차를 우리면 보통... 써요. 허브와 향신료를 더하면 쓴맛이 풍부하고 알싸한 맛으로 바뀌죠!
The Cursed One#386.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#387.src: The mushroom itself is said to keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#387.dst: 이 버섯은 건강을 지켜 준다고 해요. 저항력도 높여 준다나요!
The Cursed One#387.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#388.dst: 반면 버들송이는 좋은 블렌드 차에 딱이에요. 버섯만으로도 달콤하고 흙내음 나는 맛이 나요.
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#389.src: The mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#389.dst: 이 버섯은 건강을 되찾아 주고 피로감도 덜어 준대요! 정말 놀랍죠.
The Cursed One#389.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#390.dst: 뭘 사고 싶으시면 제 조수에게 말씀하세요.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#393.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#393.dst: 축제 시간이다! *딸꾹* 그 말은... 술 마실 시간!!!
The Cursed One#393.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#394.dst: 군침 도는 우리 음료에 과안심 있어요?
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#396.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#396.dst: *딸꾹* 오느으을은 수입 술 몇 가지랑 우리 대표 Autumn Amaretto가 있어요.
The Cursed One#396.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#397.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#397.dst: 이 근처 나무에 파란 열매 봤죠? 대부분 못 먹는 Liff 베리지마아안, 일부는 가을 열매라고 하는 먹을 만한 열매라서 값이 비싸요!
The Cursed One#397.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#398.src: The Amaretto is made from Autumn Fruit kernels! We have aaaalso mixed in some Liff Leaves which *hic* gives it its warm colour and slightly bitter and metallic taste.
The Cursed One#398.dst: Amaretto는 가을 열매 씨앗으로 만들어요! 그리고오 Liff 잎도 좀 섞었는데 *딸꾹* 그래서 따뜻한 색이랑 살짝 쌉쌀하고 쇠 맛이 나요.
The Cursed One#398.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#400.dst: 풍요로운 고지대에서 유며어엉한 헤더 맥주도 수입했어요.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#401.dst: 고지대 곳곳에서 자란 가장 아름다운 헤더를 우린 맥주예요. *딸꾹* 귀족의 풍요가 느껴질 정도라니까요.
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#402.dst: *딸꾹* 나라면 이 술은 꼬오옥 마셔 볼 거예요. 이런 건 Auburn에 잘 안 들어와요.
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#403.dst: 혀에 축복을 내리고 싶으면 저기 우리 형한테 말해요. *딸꾹*
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#406.dst: 갓 요리하고 구운 지역 음식이 있어요.
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#408.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#408.dst: 좋아요! Auburn은 진하고, 흙내음 나고, 포근한 맛으로 유명하답니다!
The Cursed One#408.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#409.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#409.dst: 야생 동물이랑 자원으로 요리하는 것도 좋아하는데, 이건 이미 다 알겠죠, 하하.
The Cursed One#409.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#410.dst: 오늘의 특별 요리를 몇 가지 소개할게요, 손님.
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#411.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#411.dst: Auburn에서 가장 중요한 요리는 당연히 "숲의 선물"이에요. 고기와 과일을 찐 잎으로 감싼 훌륭한 요리죠.
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#412.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#412.dst: 오늘 아침에 선물을 전부 손으로 싸 뒀고, 쪄서 바로 가져갈 수 있어요!
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#413.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#413.dst: 그게 별로면 전통 요리 "숲의 만찬"도 있어요. 구운 멧돼지 고기에 Mudkin 샐러드를 곁들였죠.
The Cursed One#413.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#414.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#414.dst: 아쉽지만 지금은 재료가 다 떨어졌어요. 나중에 다시 와 주세요!
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#416.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#417.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#417.dst: 내 작은 전시장에 와 줘서 기뻐요.
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#418.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps want to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#418.dst: 이 지역은 처음이에요? 우리 동물들에 대한 재미있는 사실 좀 들어 볼래요?
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#420.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#420.dst: 먼저 롤리벌레예요! 이 작은 녀석들은 여기 사람들한테 골칫거리죠.
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#421.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#421.dst: 집을 갉아 먹는 걸 좋아하거든요. 다행히 건물 대부분을 기둥 위에 지었고, 그리고오 이 벌레들은 못 기어올라요.
The Cursed One#421.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#422.dst: 자! 개구리! 북서쪽 늪이 개구리 관찰엔 최고예요. 늪 괴물만 조심하면 돼요.
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#423.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#423.dst: 개구리는 좋은 식량일지 몰라도, 우린... 반려동물로 보는 게 더 좋아요!
The Cursed One#423.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#424.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#424.dst: 마지막으로 여우예요! 이 귀염둥이들은 천성이 아주 수줍어요. 하지만 조심해요, 폭스하운드라는 더 큰 녀석들도 있거든요.
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#425.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#425.dst: 그쪽은 작은 사촌들만큼 수줍지도... 온순하지도 않아요. 그래도 귀엽긴 똑같죠!
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#426.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#428.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#428.dst: 안녕허슈, Mudkin 농장에 온 걸 환영혀!
The Cursed One#428.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#429.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#429.dst: Mudkin은 이 동네 음식에 많이 들어가는 채소여. 땅속에서 자라서 쑥 뽑아내야 혀!
The Cursed One#429.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#430.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#430.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#431.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#431.dst: 간단히 말해, 시간 끝나기 전에 점수를 최대한 많이 따는 게 목표여.
The Cursed One#431.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#432.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#432.dst: Mudkin은 크기가 세 가지고, 크기마다 점수가 정해져 있어. 근디! 생강 뿌리 두 개는 점수가 깎여.
The Cursed One#432.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#433.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#433.dst: 밭에 나타나는 흙 입자를 클릭하기만 하면 돼. 뽑을 자리는 다섯 군데여.
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#436.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.

The Cursed One#437.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#439.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.**
The Cursed One#439.dst: 축제가 왕실 중심으로 돌아가긴 해도, 우리 문화를 보여 준다는 점은 늘 좋았어요.**
The Cursed One#439.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#440.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#440.dst: 왕실과 겪은 일 때문에 우리 지방에 대한 인상이 망가지지 않았으면 해요... 여전히 기릴 만한 게 많거든요.
The Cursed One#440.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#441.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#441.dst: 가끔은 걱정을 내려놓고... 있는 그대로 받아들이는 것도 좋아요. 잠깐 숨 좀 돌리고요.
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#443.dst: 왕실과 겪은 일이 짓누르면 즐기기 어렵죠? 그 기분 알아요.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#444.dst: 음. 누릴 수 있을 때 누리라고 하고 싶어요. 내 경험상 이런 행복한 순간은 금방 지나가거든요.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra
